en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand neo‑classical columned colonnade with a coffered ceiling, stretching into the distance. The left side opens to a street lined with ornate multi‑story spa-town buildings, while the right side is framed by a dense row of columns. At the far end of the colonnade a clock and archways are visible. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.
